title: kate-search: count hits and skip an empty pattern
summary: FindBar::hit_count returns 0 when the pattern string is empty. Any other pattern uses find_all and the ? operator. The test goes in the existing bar tests module.

lane.reason: A local Qwen3.8 coder model with 27B parameters on the owner Mac codes this packet. The change is one file and stays under about 60 lines.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: bar.rs has one test module named tests.  Add the new test function at the end of that module, before its closing brace. Do not write a second mod tests. Do not add a second module with the same name. Add hit_count on FindBar. When self.pattern.is_empty(), return Ok(0). Otherwise write these exact lines. Do not match the Result by hand. let hits = crate::find_all(buf, &self.query())?; Ok(hits.len()) Do not touch find_from, replace_all, replace_one, query, expanded_replacement, or FindMode. Do not edit find_all or find_next. The test hit_count_skips_an_empty_pattern uses the existing sample helper and the buffer aba. An empty pattern returns Ok(0). The pattern a returns Ok(2). A Regex pattern of one open parenthesis returns Err. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip. Keep the change under about 60 lines.
